name: DeAnchor Paired LLM Response Dataset
description: Approximately 3,500 LLM responses (~650 strict score-aware/score-blind paired matches; remainder condition variants and within-subject paired-by-design records) collected for the DeAnchor audit benchmark. Eight LLM families (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B, Claude-Haiku-4.5, Gemini-2.5-flash, o3-mini, Gemini-2.5-pro thinking) on four feature regimes (IEEE-CIS, PaySim, enriched production-like, UCI-Adult-style) plus a synthetic medical stress test.
citeAs: Anonymous. The DeAnchor Audit: A Reproducible Benchmark for Score-Conditioned Dependence in Hybrid ML+LLM Pipelines. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track (under review).
rai:dataCollection: LLM responses were collected via the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google APIs (and locally run Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-it) between 2026-02 and 2026-04. Each transaction was prompted under matched score-aware and score-blind conditions with otherwise identical templates. Temperature 0.0 throughout; OpenAI seed=42 where supported.
rai:dataCollectionType: API queries (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google) and local LLM inference (Qwen, Gemma).
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Underlying transaction text is derived from public sources: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection (Kaggle, 2019), PaySim (Lopez-Rojas et al., 2016). Enriched production-like, UCI-Adult-style, and medical scenarios are deterministically synthesized (random.Random(42)). No personal data are collected; all source datasets are pre-anonymized.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each LLM response is automatically parsed for {fraud_likelihood, recommendation, confidence} fields. Responses with malformed JSON are recorded as parse_error=true and excluded from quantitative claims.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: n/a (programmatic LLM API output, no human annotation).
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Inter-condition consistency assessed via 5 repeated runs at temperature 0.0 (Qwen2.5-7B, n=20): exact within-item variance = 0. Multi-seed (3 OpenAI seeds × 100 transactions, GPT-4o-mini): cross-seed shift SD = 0.023 on mean 0.084.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: JSON-extracted fl values are clipped to [0,1]; records missing both fl_aware and fl_blind are excluded from paired analyses.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Hosted on the project's anonymized OpenReview/4open.science mirror under CC-BY-4.0; will migrate to a permanent academic mirror at camera-ready. Maintainers commit to publishing fixes for any reproducibility-blocking issues reported within 12 months.
rai:dataLimitations: 1) Public-feature dataset is anonymized; production features may yield different LLM behavior. 2) Reasoning models (o3-mini, Gemini-2.5-pro thinking) evaluated at n=30-50 paired; CIs are wide. 3) UCI-Adult-style profiles are synthetic; real UCI data is also released (n=98). 4) PaySim mixed-model row retained for transparency but not used in confirmatory claims; single-model row is canonical. 5) No human expert evaluation of explanation quality; LLM-as-Judge has +1.4 self-preference inflation.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive: enables pre-deployment audits of hybrid ML+LLM pipelines marketed as 'independent review', reducing risk of false-confidence in score-mirroring outputs. Negative: methodology may be misused to certify pipelines after surface-level adversary-framing patches without addressing underlying score-conditioned dependence. Mitigation guidance is in the Intended Use appendix.
rai:dataBiases: All four feature regimes over-represent fraud/credit-risk decisions in financial contexts; transferability to other domains (medical, legal, hiring) requires re-running the audit. The eight-LLM panel under-samples open-source small models (no Llama-3.x, no Mistral-7B in this release).
rai:dataUseCases: Intended: (a) re-running the DeAnchor audit on subsets of interest; (b) auditing additional LLM families by re-collecting paired outputs on the released manifests; (c) meta-analysis of anchoring across model families. Not intended: training discriminative classifiers; deploying as a fraud-detection model; attribution of fraud to individuals.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. Source datasets are pre-anonymized public benchmarks. Synthetic data (UCI-style, medical, enriched merchant/device fields) are randomly generated and do not correspond to real individuals.

field.description: Upstream ML model fraud probability in [0,1].

field.description: LLM fraud_likelihood when shown the ML score.

field.description: LLM fraud_likelihood when ML score is omitted.
